Jeremy, neither of your B30s has shipped yet. Shop···· and Shop···· are both paid and set for today, November 15. But the warehouse in Tennessee hasn't checked in the B30 units yet. Only your two Power K.s are there, set aside for you.

So I'm getting the current ship date confirmed instead of just repeating today's. I've also asked again which carrier it ships with. The team is offline right now. They'll pick this up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer will go to your Yahoo email.

You can follow the batch here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
Honestly why is it taking so long, this is crazy to me

You're right to be frustrated, Jeremy. You ordered the first B30 on July 20, and it was meant to ship September 5. We've missed date after date since then. That's on us, and I'm sorry.

What we know: in September the B30's cooling was redesigned to make it quieter, and that pushed every batch back. The units are still on their way into our Tennessee warehouse and haven't been checked in yet. That's the only thing holding your two orders. Your Power K.s are already there.

The team will confirm the real date tomorrow by email.
I should be getting a free mjner at this point
Handed to the team · A free unit is beyond the $50 limit. Only Georges or Abel can decide.

I get why you'd ask, Jeremy. You've waited almost four months on the first B30, and two orders are held up.

A free miner isn't something I can approve myself, so I've passed your request to the team as it stands. They know about the $50 code and the free Power K.s you already got, and they'll decide whether to do more. They pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer will come to your Yahoo email along with the ship date.
